messages.Teorema lui Fourier spune că orice semna: Fourier's theorem says that any periodic signal can be written as a sum of sinusoids whose frequencies are multiples of the fundamental:
messages.este operația inversă: pornind de la un: is the inverse operation: starting from a sound, we extract the amplitude and phase of each harmonic. In practice, we use the
messages.Cu cât păstrezi mai multe armonice, cu a: The more harmonics you keep, the closer the reconstructed shape is to the original. Near a sudden jump, however, oscillations remain:
messages.. El este o consecință matematică a apro: . This is a mathematical consequence of approximating a jump with a finite number of sinusoids, not a fault in the instrument.
messages.Un sunet muzical este periodic doar apro: A musical sound is only approximately periodic. Its attack and noise are not periodic, so we use the Fourier transform rather than the Fourier series for them. In real spectral analysis, the time window and noise make the spectrum look like a hill of energy rather than perfect lines.
messages.Din practică: de ce sună așa?: In practice: why does it sound this way?
messages.Frecarea întreține vibrația; corpul lemn: Friction sustains the vibration; the wooden body strengthens certain frequency bands (formants).
messages.Tuburile deschise dau toate armonicele;: Open pipes produce all harmonics; closed pipes produce only odd harmonics.
messages.Poziția degetului sau a penei poate anul: The position of the finger or pick can cancel certain harmonics.
messages.Doar armonice impare; fundamentala este: Odd harmonics only; the fundamental is one octave below that of an equivalent open pipe.
messages.Spectru sărac, sunet aproape sinusoidal,: Sparse spectrum, nearly sinusoidal sound, easy to control.
messages.„Armonică” este o componentă cu frecvenț: A 'harmonic' is a component whose frequency is an integer multiple of the fundamental. 'Partial' is the general term and includes inharmonic components too (bells, bowls, piano). 'Resonance' is the amplification of a vibration when the driving frequency approaches a natural frequency; it is not the same as an echo.

Bar height shows the band's relative level, and the frequency axis is logarithmic. Nearby bars outline the energy and do not automatically represent extra notes.
messages.FFT analizează un interval finit. Dacă i: An FFT analyzes a finite interval. If it does not contain a whole number of periods, energy also spreads to nearby discrete frequency values; this is called spectral leakage. The graph groups nearby frequencies into logarithmic bands, so one peak can appear across several bars.
messages.fₛ este frecvența de eșantionare, N numă: fₛ is the sampling frequency, N the number of samples, and T the analysis duration. Here N = 2048; at fₛ = 48 kHz, Δf ≈ 23.4 Hz and T ≈ 42.7 ms. A longer interval separates nearby frequencies more clearly.
messages.Amortizarea, atacul instrumentului, vari: Damping, the instrument's attack, amplitude changes, vibrato, and excitation noise make the signal vary over time. The instrument body's resonances change harmonic amplitudes, while string stiffness can make frequencies depart from exact integer multiples of the fundamental.
messages.Ferestrele Hann sau Blackman reduc scurg: Hann or Blackman windows reduce spectral leakage but broaden the peak; nearby frequencies are separated more clearly with a longer analysis interval.
